After reading a thread someone made, asking for help with making a smaller farm map. I decide to try and make just that, A tiny itty bitty map. This first started pretty much for that one guy but the idea of a mini farm was so funny I decided to share it with the public. As this is a edited version of my Forest map mod it uses my custom outdoors tilesheets.

If there is anything you find: bug, missing tile property, something acting like it shouldn't or not acting at all, Post a comment and let me know.
